name: value-pricing
description: Configurable, evidence-led pricing research for products, services, and other business models, with methods selected to fit the decision and available evidence.

interface.longDescription: Run configurable pricing research for products, services, and other business models. Select methods to fit the decision and evidence, assess market references, customer value, and delivery economics, then document pricing hypotheses and validation needs. Simulated research is exploratory, not a demand forecast. Python scripts need a local shell and Python 3.11 or later.
defaultPrompt: Help me estimate a defensible price for this product.
Design three pricing tiers from our value drivers and costs.
What evidence do we need before we raise our prices?
